toolRules: Use scripts/common.ps1 and the explicit .local/toolchain.local.json system MSVC/Windows SDK exception. C++/WinRT generator is from this lock. No NuGet restore or implicit global cache.
excludedTransitivePackages: Windows SDK BuildTools/MSIX packages: explicit system SDK already supplies metadata and this probe uses CMake, no XAML/MSIX build tasks. WebView2 runtime is not deployed because no WebView is instantiated. AI, ML and Widgets packages are not consumed.
deployment: Framework-dependent mode explicitly bootstraps installed Windows App Runtime 1.8 x64. Self-contained mode explicitly loads the app-local Microsoft.WindowsAppRuntime.dll from a separately staged native payload. No installer or fallback between modes.
